propositions: Close must require a separately attested plan review without running review inside close or invalidating implementations due to file changes.
CLOSE profile disables code freshness checks but retains signature, registry, material, phase, and pin enforcement validation.
Generic pre_status_check callback runs inside the existing write lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, catching plan/signature/material changes between precheck and lock.
Unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, phase incompatibility, and malformed metadata always block close; pin drift blocks only when enforce_plan_material_pins is true.
Configuration flag require_plan_review_for_close defaults false; when disabled, close performs zero plan-review reads and is byte-for-byte equivalent to current behavior.
Force-close with non-empty reason bypasses both gates with audit trail; bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, and idea→closed retain existing exemptions.
